title: VoiceTranscript
description: Final transcript of one utterance, published on voice.transcript. Partial transcripts are never published. The API publishes one with source app for every POST /voice/ask so both paths reach the same parser.

ts.description: End of utterance, or API receipt time for source app, ISO 8601 UTC.

text.description: Recognised text, at most 200 characters, empty when nothing was understood.

confidence.description: Recogniser confidence, 0.0 to 1.0, 1.0 for source app.

language.description: Recognition language as a BCP 47 tag.

duration_ms.description: Audio length, milliseconds, integer 0 to 30000, null for source app.

examples.text: set the left lights to forty percent
